_doc: Optional hand-drawn room interiors. Save <room>.png in this folder and the Great Oak draws it inside that room's box instead of the procedural art (squirrels, birds and effects still animate on top). Rebuild after adding files. The world is 600 x 1150 units; export at 4x the box size for crisp zoom (max zoom is 2.8x). v1.2 layout.
